about.label: About
about.title: Who am I?
about.intro: I'm Marc-Antoine. I design and build complete web applications, from the database all the way to the interface.
about.body: I love turning a fuzzy idea into a concrete product that is fast and pleasant to use — on phones and desktops alike. On the server I mostly work with Java and Spring Boot; on the client, with React, Next.js and TypeScript.
about.body2: When I'm not coding for a client, I build my own tools: a security camera for my cats, a Scrabble solver… and this portfolio.

catcam.name: La Catcam
catcam.tagline: Keep an eye on your pets, even far from home.
catcam.description: La Catcam is a web application built specifically to watch your pets while you're away from home.

features.title: Motion detection
features.text: Automatically records your favourite felines' mischief so you can catch them red-handed!

features.title: Privacy first
features.text: A local server in your home streams and records the videos. Nothing leaves the house.

features.title: Mobile & desktop
features.text: A simple, efficient design on every screen, with light and dark themes.

features.title: Customizable
features.text: Several aspects of the interface can be tuned to better fit your needs.

scrabble.name: Scrabble Cheetah
scrabble.tagline: The best moves for your board, in an instant.
scrabble.description: Scrabble Cheetah is an application that gives you the best possible solutions for your Scrabble board.

features.title: Bilingual
features.text: Solutions in French and English, with several types of game boards.

features.title: Saved games
features.text: Up to 8 games per account, each with a custom name and a board preview.

features.title: Interactive board
features.text: A game board that's easy to handle on desktop and on mobile.

features.title: Fast engine
features.text: A Spring Boot back-end that searches the dictionary for the highest-scoring move.
